verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 100.8 (-3.5% in a day) and momentum is 38: prices are falling. 84s cost 700, 85s 2,300 and 86s 4,600. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-11-09T13:48:00+00:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Tabitha Chawinga 89 UEFA Women's Champions League RTTK after its 23% fall, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 1,499,000 coins. Now 1,450,000. Sell the slide: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often keeps falling for another two days. Picked because it is down 23.1% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 6 of 12 so far, averaging +5.4% after tax. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy Jude Bellingham 91 UEFA Champions League RTTK after its 20% fall, sell in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 2,399,000 coins. Now 2,350,000. Buy the dip: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often recovers part of the fall within two days. Picked because it is down 20.0% in about a day. Two price readings about an hour apart agree on this price. This strategy is 1 of 4 so far, averaging -7.7% after tax. It was paused after losing calls, so this is a low-confidence retest. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-11-12T07:59:00+00:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 84s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 700 (0.84 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,300 (1.10 coins per Item Score point), 86s 4,600 (1.12 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,700 (1.22 coins per Item Score point), 88s 11,000 (1.33 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 84s then 85s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Morgan Rogers and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Morgan Rogers 87 Destined for Glory -26.7%; Marcos Llorente 88 UEFA Champions League RTTK -23.2%; Carlos Forbs 75 Rare -23.0%; Tabitha Chawinga 89 UEFA Women's Champions League RTTK -22.0%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
